Card Q&A.q: If this card has both red and black digivolution cards, can this card's [When Digivolving] effect delete both Digimon and Tamers?

Card Q&A.a: No. The total play costs of the chosen Digimon and Tamers must add up to 6 or less.
Card Q&A.q: If this card has both red and black digivolution cards, can this card's [When Digivolving] effect delete both 6 play cost worth of my opponent’s Digimon, and 6 play cost worth of my opponent’s Tamers?
If a single red and black multicolor card is in this card’s digivolution cards, can I activate both parts of this card’s [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If this Digimon has a red digivolution card, choose any number of your opponent's Digimon. If this Digimon has a black digivolution card, choose any number of your opponent's Tamers. The chosen cards' play costs must add up to 6 or less. Delete the chosen cards.
[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, you may unsuspend this Digimon.
